entry.title: What an EPCC contractor does
entry.summary: EPCC stands for engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning — one contractor, one point of responsibility from first drawing to a plant that runs. What each phase commits, why the single-source format wins, and the documented record behind it at PT Maharani Prima.
